content.text:
Refactor phase complete. Three refactorings applied, tests green after each.

## Naming Evaluation (first priority)

`nextGeneration`, `neighborsOf`, `isSameCell`, `contains`, `candidates` all still fit. One did not: **`survives`**. After the Green phase widened the candidate set, that function also decides *births* — asking whether a dead cell "survives" is a contradiction. Renamed to **`isAliveNextGeneration`**, which covers both survival and birth.

## Refactorings Applied

**1. Rule 3 (conceptual duplication) — deleted `isNeighbor`**

`isNeighbor` (Chebyshev-distance test) and `neighborsOf` (explicit 8-offset list) were two independent encodings of the same domain concept, "adjacency". A change to one silently diverges from the other. `countLiveNeighbors` now reuses `neighborsOf` + `contains`, and `isNeighbor` is gone.

**2. Rule 2 + Rule 4 — mutation-free `candidates`**

The imperative accumulate-and-`push` loop became a named `withoutDuplicates` helper plus a one-line `candidates`. The dedup concept now has a name instead of being an inline mechanism, and the mutable accumulator is gone.

**3. Rule 2 — `isAliveNextGeneration`**

Rename plus an explaining variable `isCurrentlyAlive`, collapsing the `if`/`return` pair into the single canonical rule `liveNeighbors === 3 || (liveNeighbors === 2 && isCurrentlyAlive)` — one expression of "three neighbors always yields life; two only sustains existing life".

## APP Mass

| Element | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `isNeighbor` | 28 | — (deleted) |
| `isSameCell` | 10 | 10 |
| `contains` | 12 | 12 |
| `neighborsOf` | 38 | 38 |
| `countLiveNeighbors` | 12 | 14 |
| `withoutDuplicates` | — | 22 |
| `candidates` | 31 | 14 |
| `survives` → `isAliveNextGeneration` | 22 | 18 |
| `nextGeneration` | 13 | 13 |
| **Total** | **166** | **141** |

**Δ −25.**

Honest note on refactoring 2: `candidates` + `withoutDuplicates` is 36 versus the old 31 — mass went *up* by 5. Extracting the helper costs a second iteration (`findIndex` inside `filter`, loop mass 5) that the single mutating loop avoided. I kept it anyway because Rule 2 trumps APP: the assignment (mass 6) and the unnamed dedup mechanism were the clarity problem, and naming the concept is worth 5 units. The overall −25 comes from deleting `isNeighbor`.
